Q: How to open a wsl directory in git bash terminal A:

Run this command:

cd //wsl.localhost/Ubuntu

The command \\wsl.localhost\Ubuntu didn't work, because

  1. Bash removes backslashes while parsing the command \\wsl.localhost\Ubuntu (solution: use forward slashes: /; alternative solution: use quotes).

  2. You didn't indicate that you want to change the current directory, without that Bash interpreted your command as running an external program by that name (solution: use the cd command).

Q: Magic Leap 2 - is there an equivalent to Holographic Remoting (Hololens2)? A:

As I know there is no direct equivalent of HoloLens 2 Holographic Remoting in Magic Leap 2. The closest feature is Zero Iteration (ZI), but it works differently. ZI is mainly a development and simulation tool that allows you to run and test your Unity application quickly in Play Mode or a lab environment, and optionally stream it to the device for iteration. However, unlike HoloLens Remoting, it does not execute the application on a Windows PC or use the PC for rendering. The app still runs within the Magic Leap runtime, and ZI is primarily meant to speed up development and testing rather than provide true remote rendering.

Here is quick comparison

Feature HoloLens 2 Remoting Magic Leap 2 ZI
App runs on PC Yes No
Device acts as remote display Yes No
Full remote rendering Yes No
Fast iteration without builds Yes Yes (simulation/lab mode)
Primary purpose PC offloading + streaming Development + testing

CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[udfNumberInWords] (@Number bigint)
RETURNS nvarchar(1500)
WITH EXECUTE AS CALLER
AS
BEGIN
 
   DECLARE @Negative nvarchar(10) = '';
   DECLARE @Word nvarchar(1500) = '';
 
   IF @Number < 0 
      BEGIN
         SET @Negative = 'Negative ';
         SET @Number = -@Number;
      END
 
   IF @Number = 0 
      SET @Word = '';
 
   IF @Number BETWEEN 1 AND 19
      SET @Word = CASE 
               WHEN @Number =  1 THEN 'One'    
               WHEN @Number =  2 THEN 'Two'
               WHEN @Number =  3 THEN 'Three'
               WHEN @Number =  4 THEN 'Four'
               WHEN @Number =  5 THEN 'Five'
               WHEN @Number =  6 THEN 'Six'
               WHEN @Number =  7 THEN 'Seven'
               WHEN @Number =  8 THEN 'Eight'
               WHEN @Number =  9 THEN 'Nine'
               WHEN @Number = 10 THEN 'Ten'
               WHEN @Number = 11 THEN 'Eleven'
               WHEN @Number = 12 THEN 'Twelve'
               WHEN @Number = 13 THEN 'Thirteen'
               WHEN @Number = 14 THEN 'Fourteen'
               WHEN @Number = 15 THEN 'Fifteen'
               WHEN @Number = 16 THEN 'Sixteen'
               WHEN @Number = 17 THEN 'Seventeen'
               WHEN @Number = 18 THEN 'Eighteen'
               WHEN @Number = 19 THEN 'Nineteen'
            END;
 
   IF @Number BETWEEN 20 AND 99
      SET @Word = CASE 
               WHEN @Number / 10 = 2 THEN 'Twenty'
               WHEN @Number / 10 = 3 THEN 'Thirty'
               WHEN @Number / 10 = 4 THEN 'Forty'
               WHEN @Number / 10 = 5 THEN 'Fifty'
               WHEN @Number / 10 = 6 THEN 'Sixty'
               WHEN @Number / 10 = 7 THEN 'Seventy'
               WHEN @Number / 10 = 8 THEN 'Eighty'
               WHEN @Number / 10 = 9 THEN 'Ninety'
            END + 
            CASE WHEN @Number % 10 > 0 THEN '-' + [dbo].[udfNumberInWords] (@Number % 10)
               ELSE ''
            END;
 
   IF @Number BETWEEN 100 AND 999
      SET @Word = [dbo].[udfNumberInWords] (@Number / 100) + ' Hundred ' + [dbo].[udfNumberInWords] (@Number % 100);
 
   IF @Number BETWEEN 1000 AND 999999
      SET @Word = [dbo].[udfNumberInWords] (@Number / 1000) + ' Thousand ' + [dbo].[udfNumberInWords] (@Number % 1000);
 
   IF @Number BETWEEN 1000000 AND 999999999
      SET @Word = [dbo].[udfNumberInWords] (@Number / 1000000) + ' Million ' + [dbo].[udfNumberInWords] (@Number % 1000000);
 
   IF @Number BETWEEN 1000000000 AND 999999999999
      SET @Word = [dbo].[udfNumberInWords] (@Number / 1000000000) + ' Billion ' + [dbo].[udfNumberInWords] (@Number % 1000000000);
 
   IF @Number BETWEEN 1000000000000 AND 999999999999999
      SET @Word = [dbo].[udfNumberInWords] (@Number / 1000000000000) + ' Trillion ' + [dbo].[udfNumberInWords] (@Number % 1000000000000);
 
   SET @Word = TRIM(@Negative + @Word);
 
   RETURN @Word;
 
END
---------------
create FUNCTION dbo.udfINRNumberInWords  
(  
    @Number BIGINT  
)  
RETURNS NVARCHAR(2000)  
WITH EXECUTE AS CALLER  
AS  
BEGIN  
    DECLARE @Negative NVARCHAR(10) = '';  
    DECLARE @Word NVARCHAR(2000) = '';  
  
    IF @Number < 0  
    BEGIN  
        SET @Negative = 'Negative ';  
        SET @Number = ABS(@Number);  
    END  
  
    IF @Number = 0  
        RETURN 'Zero';  
  
    -- 1 to 19  
    IF @Number BETWEEN 1 AND 19  
        SET @Word = CASE @Number  
            WHEN 1 THEN 'One'       WHEN 2 THEN 'Two'  
            WHEN 3 THEN 'Three'    WHEN 4 THEN 'Four'  
            WHEN 5 THEN 'Five'     WHEN 6 THEN 'Six'  
            WHEN 7 THEN 'Seven'    WHEN 8 THEN 'Eight'  
            WHEN 9 THEN 'Nine'     WHEN 10 THEN 'Ten'  
            WHEN 11 THEN 'Eleven'  WHEN 12 THEN 'Twelve'  
            WHEN 13 THEN 'Thirteen'WHEN 14 THEN 'Fourteen'  
            WHEN 15 THEN 'Fifteen' WHEN 16 THEN 'Sixteen'  
            WHEN 17 THEN 'Seventeen'WHEN 18 THEN 'Eighteen'  
            WHEN 19 THEN 'Nineteen'  
        END;  
  
    -- 20 to 99  
    ELSE IF @Number BETWEEN 20 AND 99  
        SET @Word =  
            CASE @Number / 10  
                WHEN 2 THEN 'Twenty'  WHEN 3 THEN 'Thirty'  
                WHEN 4 THEN 'Forty'   WHEN 5 THEN 'Fifty'  
                WHEN 6 THEN 'Sixty'   WHEN 7 THEN 'Seventy'  
                WHEN 8 THEN 'Eighty'  WHEN 9 THEN 'Ninety'  
            END +  
            CASE WHEN @Number % 10 > 0  
                 THEN ' ' + dbo.udfINRNumberInWords(@Number % 10)  
                 ELSE '' END;  
  
    -- 100 to 999  
    ELSE IF @Number BETWEEN 100 AND 999  
        SET @Word =  
            dbo.udfINRNumberInWords(@Number / 100) +  
            ' Hundred' +  
            CASE WHEN @Number % 100 > 0  
                 THEN ' ' + dbo.udfINRNumberInWords(@Number % 100)  
                 ELSE '' END;  
  
    -- Thousand  
    ELSE IF @Number BETWEEN 1000 AND 99999  
        SET @Word =  
            dbo.udfINRNumberInWords(@Number / 1000) +  
            ' Thousand' +  
            CASE WHEN @Number % 1000 > 0  
                 THEN ' ' + dbo.udfINRNumberInWords(@Number % 1000)  
                 ELSE '' END;  
  
    -- Lakh  
    ELSE IF @Number BETWEEN 100000 AND 9999999  
        SET @Word =  
            dbo.udfINRNumberInWords(@Number / 100000) +  
            ' Lakh' +  
            CASE WHEN @Number % 100000 > 0  
                 THEN ' ' + dbo.udfINRNumberInWords(@Number % 100000)  
                 ELSE '' END;  
  
    -- Crore  
    ELSE IF @Number BETWEEN 10000000 AND 999999999  
        SET @Word =  
            dbo.udfINRNumberInWords(@Number / 10000000) +  
            ' Crore' +  
            CASE WHEN @Number % 10000000 > 0  
                 THEN ' ' + dbo.udfINRNumberInWords(@Number % 10000000)  
                 ELSE '' END;  
  
    -- Arab  
    ELSE IF @Number BETWEEN 1000000000 AND 99999999999  
        SET @Word =  
            dbo.udfINRNumberInWords(@Number / 1000000000) +  
            ' Arab' +  
            CASE WHEN @Number % 1000000000 > 0  
                 THEN ' ' + dbo.udfINRNumberInWords(@Number % 1000000000)  
                 ELSE '' END;  
  
    -- Kharab  
    ELSE IF @Number BETWEEN 100000000000 AND 9999999999999  
        SET @Word =  
            dbo.udfINRNumberInWords(@Number / 100000000000) +  
            ' Kharab' +  
            CASE WHEN @Number % 100000000000 > 0  
                 THEN ' ' + dbo.udfINRNumberInWords(@Number % 100000000000)  
                 ELSE '' END;  
  
    RETURN LTRIM(RTRIM(@Negative + @Word));  
END

create FUNCTION dbo.udfINRAmountInWords
(
    @Amount MONEY
)
RETURNS NVARCHAR(2000)
WITH EXECUTE AS CALLER
AS
BEGIN
    DECLARE 
        @Negative NVARCHAR(10) = '',
        @Result   NVARCHAR(2000) = '',
        @Rupees   BIGINT,
        @Paisa    INT;

    -- Handle negative values
    IF @Amount < 0
    BEGIN
        SET @Negative = 'Negative ';
        SET @Amount = ABS(@Amount);
    END;

    -- Split Rupees and Paisa (2 decimal places)
    SET @Rupees = FLOOR(@Amount);
    SET @Paisa  = ROUND((@Amount - @Rupees) * 100, 0);

    -- Rupees part
    IF @Rupees > 0
        SET @Result = dbo.udfINRNumberInWords(@Rupees) + ' Rupee';
    ELSE
        SET @Result = 'Zero Rupee';

    -- Paisa part
    IF @Paisa > 0
        SET @Result = @Result 
                    + ' and ' 
                    + dbo.udfINRNumberInWords(@Paisa) 
                    + ' Paisa';

    RETURN LTRIM(RTRIM(@Negative + @Result));
END;
GO

CREATE FUNCTION dbo.udfCurrencyInWords
(
    @Money money,
    @DollarSuffix nvarchar(10),
    @DollarCentsSuffix nvarchar(10)
)
RETURNS nvarchar(1500)
WITH EXECUTE AS CALLER
AS
BEGIN
    DECLARE 
        @Words nvarchar(1500) = '',
        @Dollars bigint,
        @Cents int,
        @Negative nvarchar(10) = '';

    -- Handle negative values
    IF @Money < 0
    BEGIN
        SET @Negative = 'Negative ';
        SET @Money = ABS(@Money);
    END;

    -- Split dollars and cents safely
    SET @Dollars = FLOOR(@Money);
    SET @Cents = ROUND((@Money - @Dollars) * 100, 0);

    -- Dollars part
    IF @Dollars > 0
    BEGIN
        SET @Words = dbo.udfNumberInWords(@Dollars) + ' ' + @DollarSuffix;
    END;

    -- Cents part
    IF @Cents > 0
    BEGIN
        IF @Dollars > 0
            SET @Words = @Words + ' and ';

        SET @Words = @Words 
                   + dbo.udfNumberInWords(@Cents) 
                   + ' ' + @DollarCentsSuffix;
    END;

    -- Zero case
    IF @Dollars = 0 AND @Cents = 0
        SET @Words = 'Zero ' + @DollarSuffix;

    RETURN @Negative + @Words;
END;
GO

BEGIN
SET @Major = (SELECT TOP 1 isnull(MajorUnitName,'') FROM @Currency WHERE CurrencyCode = UPPER(@ccode));
SET @Minor = (SELECT TOP 1 isnull(MinorUnitName,'') FROM @Currency WHERE CurrencyCode = UPPER(@ccode));
SET @WORD = dbo.udfINRCurrencyInWords(@Amount,@Major,@Minor);
END
ELSE IF UPPER(@ccode) in (select distinct CurrencyCode from @Currency)
BEGIN
SET @Major = (SELECT TOP 1 isnull(MajorUnitName,'') FROM @Currency WHERE CurrencyCode = UPPER(@ccode));
SET @Minor = (SELECT TOP 1 isnull(MinorUnitName,'') FROM @Currency WHERE CurrencyCode = UPPER(@ccode));
SET @WORD = dbo.udfCurrencyInWords(@Amount,@Major,@Minor);END
ELSE
BEGIN
SET @WORD = 'Unsupported currency';
END
RETURN LTRIM(RTRIM(@WORD))
end
